name: se-widget-studio
description: A local, deterministic development and media studio for StreamElements Custom Widgets.

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/unit/*.test.mjs tests/integration/*.test.mjs
scripts.studio: npm run build && node dist/cli/index.js dev examples/basic-chat
scripts.validate:example: npm run build && node dist/cli/index.js validate examples/basic-chat
scripts.smoke:example: npm run build && node dist/cli/index.js test examples/basic-chat
